playbookOutputs: CSD login credentials confirmed for the client
playbookCommonFailures: Bank account verification fails because the account holder name on CSD does not match the bank's records exactly
SARS tax compliance status not Compliant, so the tax section of the profile shows non-compliant
Director ID numbers do not match CIPC / Home Affairs records and the CIPC verification fails
OTP for the CSD profile goes to the client's phone and the client is unavailable, stalling the registration
Commodity / industry classification left incomplete so the profile is not 'Registered'

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC Certificate)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3, CK1, CK2 or MOI document showing company registration number, registered enterprise name and active directors. CSD verifies these against CIPC automatically.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business bank account - not older than 3 months
alternatives: Recent bank statement showing account holder name, account number and branch code
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter or statement from a registered South African bank, in the COMPANY's name, dated within 3 months. Extract account holder name exactly as the bank spells it, account number, account type and branch code — CSD verifies these with the bank.

informationToProvide.label: SARS Tax Compliance Status Certificate
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status letter or PIN printout for the company showing 'Compliant'. CSD links to SARS using the company tax number; note the income tax reference number.

informationToProvide.label: Valid South African ID documents  / Passport of all directors / members
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address
alternatives: Director's proof of address where the business operates from home
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, lease, rates account or statement dated within 3 months showing the physical business address. Extract street, suburb, city, province and postal code for the CSD address screen.

informationToProvide.label: Details of goods and services the supplier can provide
informationToProvide.helpText: List what the business sells or does so we can select the correct CSD commodity codes.

informationToProvide.label: Details about the industry or sectors in which the supplier operates
Preferred cell number
informationToProvide.helpText: CSD sends one-time PINs to this number; the person must be reachable during registration.

informationToProvide.label: B-BBEE certificate or sworn affidavit
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid B-BBEE certificate from a SANAS-accredited agency or a commissioned EME/QSE sworn affidavit (dtic template) for the company. Optional but strengthens the profile; offer the BEE Certificate service if missing.

informationToProvide.label: Core Goods / Services Supplied (Commodity Families) & Provinces / Municipalities Served
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the main goods or services your business supplies to government and whether you deliver nationally or in specific provinces/municipalities.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect company, bank, tax, director and contact details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads and questionnaire fields received; contact person available for OTPs
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that CSD registration is free and that the CSD profile is created in the client's name — the preferred email and cell number become the login and receive one-time PINs, so the contact person must be reachable while we register. Ask whether the company already has a CSD profile (an existing MAAA number) — if yes, this is a Profile Update, not a registration. Offer the BEE affidavit service if no B-BBEE document exists.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents and tax compliance
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Uploads pass; bank details extracted verbatim; director IDs match the CoR14.3; TCS is Compliant
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Bank verification on CSD is the usual failure point: capture the account holder name exactly as on the bank letter (including '(Pty) Ltd' spelling). Verify the TCS PIN on eFiling — if non-compliant, the profile will still register but show tax non-compliant, which disqualifies tenders; tell the client and propose the Tax Clearance service. Map the goods/services answer to CSD commodity categories (UNSPSC-style tree) and list the proposed codes on the handoff sheet.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft CSD profile handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet covers every CSD screen: supplier identification, contacts, addresses, bank, tax, directors, commodities, industry classification, B-BBEE, associations
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: One section per CSD screen with values ready to type. Include income tax number, CIPC number, bank account holder/number/type/branch, each director's name/ID/designation, physical and postal address, commodity codes, industry (SIC) selection and B-BBEE status/level. Mark anything missing rather than guessing.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Create supplier profile on csd.gov.za
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Profile created, every mandatory section complete, bank and CIPC/SARS verifications triggered; supplier number (MAAA) issued
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: secure.csd.gov.za > Register. Create the user account with the client's preferred email and cell (OTP required — coordinate with the contact). Complete each section in order; the supplier number is only issued once all mandatory sections are saved. Bank details trigger an overnight verification with the bank; CIPC and SARS checks run automatically. Store the CSD username and password as secrets on the order and share them with the client only via the secure channel.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for bank and SARS verification to complete
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Bank status 'Verified', tax status 'Compliant' and CIPC status 'Verified' on the profile; registration report downloadable
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Log in and check the verification statuses rather than waiting on email. If bank verification fails, compare the account holder name to the bank letter and correct; if SARS shows non-compliant, propose the Tax Clearance service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CSD registration report and supplier number
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registration report (PDF), MAAA number and login details posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that the CSD profile must be kept current (bank, tax and B-BBEE) and that the report is what government buyers request. Offer CSD Profile Updates as an annual service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
